highlights_headline: The next 4.159 release drops Linux x86 native assets.
highlights_body: Linux applications using 32-bit x86 native packages will need to move to a supported architecture.

breaking.title: Move Linux x86 applications to a supported architecture
breaking.body: Linux x86 native builds and NuGet asset entries have been removed. Retarget applications that depend on those 32-bit assets to a supported Linux architecture, such as x64 or ARM64, before upgrading.
